organization.description: Enable previews for everyone while they are using this organization. New members inherit these defaults automatically.

blobStorage.title: Blob Storage Integration
blobStorage.description: Configure scheduled exports of your trace data to AWS S3, S3-compatible storage, or Azure Blob Storage. Set up an hourly, daily, or weekly export to your own storage for data analysis or backup. Use the "Validate" button to test your configuration by uploading a small test file, and "Run Now" to trigger an immediate export.
blobStorage.planUnavailable: This feature is not available in your current plan.
blobStorage.validationUnavailable: This export source is not available on this deployment. Select an available export source to save.

provider.label: Storage Provider
provider.azureContainerDescription: Azure container name (3-63 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only)
provider.forcePathStyleDescription: Enable for MinIO and some other S3 compatible providers
provider.awsAccessKeySelfHostedDescription: Your AWS IAM user access key ID. Leave empty to use host credentials (IAM roles, instance profiles, etc.)
provider.awsAccessKeyDescription: Your AWS IAM user access key ID
provider.s3AccessKeyDescription: Access key for your S3-compatible storage
provider.azureAccountKeyDescription: Your Azure storage account access key
provider.awsSecretSelfHostedDescription: Your AWS IAM user secret access key. Leave empty to use host credentials (IAM roles, instance profiles, etc.)
provider.awsSecretDescription: Your AWS IAM user secret access key
provider.s3SecretDescription: Secret key for your S3-compatible storage
provider.azurePrefixDescription: Optional prefix path for exported files in your Azure container (e.g., "langfuse-exports/")
provider.s3PrefixDescription: Optional prefix path for exported files in your S3 bucket (e.g., "langfuse-exports/")
provider.prefixDescription: Optional prefix path for exported files (e.g., "langfuse-exports/")

schedule.frequencyDescription: How often the data should be exported. Changes are taken into consideration from the next run onwards.
schedule.parquetDescription: Apache Parquet is a columnar binary format encoded and compressed by ClickHouse. Gzip compression does not apply.
schedule.fileTypeDescription: The file format for exported data.
schedule.modeDescription: Choose when to start exporting data. "Today" and "Custom date" modes will not include historical data before the specified date.
schedule.startDateDescription: Data before this date will not be included in exports

source.label: Export Source
source.description: Choose which data sources to export to blob storage. Scores are always included.
source.unavailableTitle: Saved export source is no longer available

fieldGroups.label: Export Field Groups
fieldGroups.description: Choose which field groups to include in observation exports. Deselect large groups (e.g. Input / Output) to reduce export size, or privacy-sensitive groups (e.g. Metadata) to avoid storing user data.
fieldGroups.legacyOnlyDescription: Traces and scores are always exported in full. Field groups that only exist on enriched observations (e.g. Trace Context) are not available for this export source.
fieldGroups.mixedDescription: Traces and scores are always exported in full. Fields that only exist on enriched observations (e.g. Trace Context) are omitted from the legacy observations export.
fieldGroups.eventsDescription: Scores are always exported in full.

mixpanel.title: Mixpanel Integration
mixpanel.description: Integrate with <link>Mixpanel</link> to sync your Langfuse traces, generations, and scores for advanced product analytics. Upon activation, all historical project data is synced. New data is then synced every hour to keep your Mixpanel dashboards up to date.
mixpanel.regionDescription: Select the Mixpanel region where your project is hosted
mixpanel.keepToken: Leave blank to keep the current token.
mixpanel.tokenHelp: You can find your Project Token in your Mixpanel project settings
mixpanel.sourceDescription: Choose which data sources to export to Mixpanel. Scores are always included.
mixpanel.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset the Mixpanel integration for this project?

posthog.title: PostHog Integration
posthog.description: We have teamed up with <link>PostHog</link> (OSS product analytics) to make Langfuse events and metrics available in your PostHog dashboards. Upon activation, all historical project data is synced. New data is then synced every hour to keep your PostHog dashboards up to date.
posthog.hostnameDescription: US region: https://us.posthog.com; EU region: https://eu.posthog.com
posthog.keyRequired: PostHog Project API Key is required
posthog.keepKey: Leave blank to keep the current API key.
posthog.sourceDescription: Choose which data sources to export to PostHog. Scores are always included.
posthog.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset the PostHog integration for this project?

slack.title: Slack Integration
slack.testDescription: Test your Slack integration by sending a message to a channel.
slack.availableAfterTest: Available after sending a test message
slack.noSelection: Select a channel above to view its details and test message delivery. For private channels, invite the app first with <command>/invite @Langfuse</command> in that channel.

webCallouts.title: Web Callouts
webCallouts.description: Configure a project-level callout. Users can trigger a POST to an endpoint from trace, observation, and session detail screens to start workflows in your services. See the <docs>docs</docs> for more information.
webCallouts.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have permission to manage integrations for this project.
webCallouts.limit: Currently you can only create one callout per project.
webCallouts.deletedDescription: The endpoint was removed from this project.
webCallouts.dialogDescription: Langfuse sends a backend JSON POST when a user clicks a web callout action. <docs>View docs</docs>.

form.name: Name
form.urlDescription: HTTP or HTTPS URL. Custom ports are allowed. The endpoint is called from the Langfuse backend.
form.enabledDescription: Shows the callout action in trace, observation, and session detail headers.
form.toastDescription: Shown after the backend callout succeeds.
form.headersDescription: Optional headers added to the backend POST. Content-Type is set automatically. Leave values empty for existing header names to keep encrypted values.
form.blockedHeader: This header is set by Langfuse and cannot be customized.

webCallouts.deleteDescription: This removes the configured endpoint and hides the web callout action.
webCallouts.cardDescription: Send backend callouts from trace, observation, and session detail views to your own application.
